scope: Retrospective uncertainty and decision analysis of the already published-in-draft Table 2 counts. This local specification precedes computation of the new intervals. The 14 PMLB tasks and the published counts were previously examined.
drop_quarter: Veto iff 4*(anchor_k-k) >= anchor_k. One fixed task-agnostic rule motivated by a deletion size in the uniform design. These outcomes never tune its threshold.
event: Original three-percent joint external refit failure (five percent for rare-positive AP, as applicable). Positive decision is veto. No outer-test-based model selection.
resampling: Sample 14 tasks with replacement. Primary: separately for each sampled task instance sample three of its three outer folds with replacement. Sensitivity: use all three folds intact for every sampled task. Use the same task draws for both analyses and identical task/fold draws for every rule, cohort and paired contrast. Keep all proposals in a fold together. No resampling of proposals, test rows, or ballots.
estimands: Table 2: pool confusion counts before taking ratios. Equal-task/fold sensitivity: normalize counts by proposals within each fold, average the three sampled fold proportions within each task instance, then average equally across sampled task instances. Derive rates, risks and contrasts from their joint confusion masses. Tabulate task/fold event denominators. Conditional rates are missing if their total class mass is zero; tabulate valid draws per interval.
intervals: Pointwise equal-tailed 95% nonparametric percentile intervals at empirical quantile orders, using numpy inverted_cdf. Intervals describe reweighting variability on the archived task/fold collection. Task-only sensitivity retains all within-task dependence from overlapping outer training sets.
paired: Each rule minus endpoints, separating minus each other rule. Report paired TPR, FPR and class-weighted joint error probability differences, and cost differences per proposal. Endpoints and more conservative or permissive baselines are also contrasted in the deterministic cost frontier.
cost: C_FP=1, r=C_FN/C_FP >= 0. L=(FP+r*FN)/N. At externally specified failure prevalence p, L=(1-p)*FPR+r*p*(1-TPR). Use explicit pooled and equally weighted observed prevalences. Illustrate prevalence reweighting at 0.1, 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75 under transportable class-conditional rates.
thresholds: Calculate the exact finite-cost inequalities for separating against all comparators, reporting ties, dominance and reversed crossings. For nested policy pairs, use a paired zero-inclusion sensitivity range for the crossover. Bootstrap draws identical at every ratio span [0,infinity]; draws with added false alarms but zero extra detections cross only at infinity. Form the 2.5th percentile of lower and 97.5th percentile of upper draw endpoints. For nonnested pairs report paired cost contrasts on the locked grid and orientation counts. Do not discard undefined ratios or report a conditional-on-finite interval.
frontier: Solve all pairwise linear cost inequalities over r>=0 for the eight published policies, both constants and the fixed deletion-size baseline. Record closed optimal intervals, including point-only ties. Pointwise bootstrap costs do not validate a selected policy. No tuning or randomized policies.
